build_FullObsMinigridPolicyNet: build a FullObsMinigridPolicyNet model with observation shape and num actions for fully observed Minigrid environments
build_MinigridPolicyNet: build a MinigridPolicyNet model with LSTM core for partial observation Minigrid policy learning
build_MinigridStateEmbeddingNet: build a MinigridStateEmbeddingNet to extract state embeddings from partial observation frames
build_MinigridInverseDynamicsNet: build a MinigridInverseDynamicsNet to predict action logits from state and next state embeddings
build_MarioDoomPolicyNet: build a MarioDoomPolicyNet model with LSTM core for Mario or Doom policy learning
